purpose: DM-requested appearances retained independently of production usage counts. These are not additions to the player appearance picker.

diffuse.encoding: BC3 with full mip chain; opaque alpha; vertically flipped for NWN DDS coordinates

illumination.encoding: RGB red-emitter mask from the source diffuse; native TGA orientation

eyes.geometry: Original 272 eye triangles separated from the head mesh; original SWTOR eye UVs restored. Head, mask and eye positions/normals are unchanged.
eyes.glow: Only the amber irises emit; pupils and sclera stay dark.

neckVariants.correction: Female authored and fitted models exchange the two original variants; canonical model/material IDs and matching original masks are preserved.
